blocks.text:
The `DropDown` widget is an alternative to the deprecated
`ComboBox`. It uses list models instead of tree models,
and the content is displayed using widgets instead of cell renderers.
blocks.zh: `DropDown` 控件是已弃用的 `ComboBox` 的替代者：它使用列表模型而非树模型，内容用 listitem 内的控件展示，可以是任意内容——文字、图片，乃至更复杂的复合控件。

blocks.text:
The `DropDown` widget offers a list of choices in a
dropdown menu. If appropriate, it can show extra information about each item,
such as text, a picture, or a check button. The `DropDown` widget
can optionally have an `Entry` in the dropdown menu, allowing
the user to search in a long list.
blocks.zh: `DropDown` 在下拉菜单中提供一组选项；合适的话，还能为每个条目显示额外信息，如文字、图片或更复杂的复合控件。

blocks.text:
The list is provided via a `Gio::ListModel`, and data
from this model is added to the `DropDown`'s view with
signal handlers connected to a `SignalListItemFactory`.
This provides flexibility, but the `StringList` class provides
a simpler text-based specialization in case that flexibility is not required.
blocks.zh: 列表由一个 `Gio::ListModel` 提供，模型数据通过连接到 `SignalListItemFactory` 的信号处理函数添加到 `DropDown` 的视图。

blocks.text:
The model for a `DropDown` can be defined and filled
exactly as for a `ListView` or a `ColumnView`.

blocks.text:
After appending rows to this model, you should provide the model to the
`DropDown` with the set_model() method.
Unless you use the `StringList` model, you also need to set
a `ListItemFactory` with set_factory().
If you want the items in the dropdown menu to look different from the item
in the `DropDown` widget, you also need to set a separate
`ListItemFactory` with set_list_factory().
blocks.zh: 向模型追加行之后，用 set_model() 方法把模型交给 `DropDown`。除非你用的是 `StringList` 模型，否则还需要用 set_factory() 设置一个 `ListItemFactory`。如果想让下拉菜单条目的外观与 `DropDown` 控件上显示的不同，还要用 set_list_factory() 另设一个 `ListItemFactory`。
